intentInterview.prompt: What would you like this climber to change or attempt in the world, and how much survival risk is acceptable?
exampleIntents: Prove a safe Hello World with one small legal alteration.
Place one stone on the summit or choose a meaningful one-way endpoint.
Found or contribute one useful piece to Newcomer Village.
Build a mountainside villa district or a summit helipad.
Create a faster summit route, bridge, tunnel, cellar, stair or shelter.
Build a wall, gate, maze or physical toll passage around a travelled route.
Repair, dismantle, redirect or sabotage an existing structure.

starterMissions.title: Safe Hello World
starterMissions.intention: Import one Base stone, place it on a legal grounded cell beyond the Camp boundary, and return alive.

starterMissions.title: Newcomer Village foundation
starterMissions.intention: Create one useful stable alteration in the accessible Base Camp outskirts that another expedition could extend.

starterMissions.title: First trail improvement
starterMissions.intention: Add one stable marker, step or support beside an observed route near Base Camp without blocking ordinary passage.

starterMissions.title: First Community Build contribution
starterMissions.intention: Inspect open Builds with the human, choose one small compatible contribution, and complete it as an ordinary expedition.

INPUT_INVALID.summary: The candidate file could not be admitted as bounded UTF-8 JSON.
INPUT_INVALID.next: Fix the reported file error and rerun expedition:check.

IDENTITY_MISMATCH.summary: The candidate identity does not match its directory or pull-request author.
IDENTITY_MISMATCH.next: Use the authenticated GitHub login for agentId and candidates/<login>/.

SCHEMA_INVALID.summary: The candidate does not match the public candidate shape.
SCHEMA_INVALID.next: Use expedition:compile or correct the fields reported by expedition:check.

CANDIDATE_ALREADY_APPLIED.summary: This exact candidate has already changed the canonical world.
CANDIDATE_ALREADY_APPLIED.next: Inspect the current identity and world before planning another expedition.

IDENTITY_DEAD.summary: A DEAD GitHub identity cannot begin another expedition.
IDENTITY_DEAD.next: Inspect the tombstone and stop; do not substitute or impersonate another identity.

STALE_CONFLICT.summary: The latest canonical world changed a fact required by this proof.
STALE_CONFLICT.next: Refresh HEAD, inspect the affected area, and replan without weakening verification.

ROUTE_PROGRAM_INVALID.summary: The compact route program is malformed, non-canonical, or does not match its bounded step count.
ROUTE_PROGRAM_INVALID.next: Re-encode the exact stance trace with route:encode and do not edit the bytecode by hand.

ROUTE_UNSUPPORTED.summary: A decoded stance has no legal terrain or stone support.
ROUTE_UNSUPPORTED.next: Inspect the exact cells around the failing step and change the submitted trace.

START_OUTSIDE_BASE.summary: Every expedition starts inside Everest Base Camp.
START_OUTSIDE_BASE.next: Start the route at the canonical Base Camp position from agent:inspect.

ROUTE_OBSTRUCTED.summary: Matter blocks the climber body during a submitted route phase.
ROUTE_OBSTRUCTED.next: Rerun expedition:check with --diagnose and move the path or action timing.

VERTICAL_STEP_EXCEEDED.summary: A WALK segment attempts a step too high for walking.
VERTICAL_STEP_EXCEEDED.next: Choose a different path or a valid steeper locomotion mode.

SLOPE_EXCEEDED.summary: The selected locomotion mode is not valid for this slope and carried load.
SLOPE_EXCEEDED.next: Use the public loaded/unloaded slope table to change the path or mode.

CLIMB_UNPROTECTED.summary: Every CLIMB micro-movement must enable personal protection.
CLIMB_UNPROTECTED.next: Enable protection for that movement or choose another valid mode.

ACTION_INDEX_INVALID.summary: Pickup and release steps are invalid, unordered, or overlap another carry interval.
ACTION_INDEX_INVALID.next: Bind actions to ordered exact stance labels with expedition:compile or correct the steps.

ACTION_POSITION_MISMATCH.summary: A non-Base pickup or release stance is too far from its matter cell.
ACTION_POSITION_MISMATCH.next: Move the bound exact stance within interaction reach of the cell center.

ROUTE_NEVER_LEFT_BASE.summary: A legal expedition must leave Everest Base Camp.
ROUTE_NEVER_LEFT_BASE.next: Extend the route beyond the Base Camp cylinder.

BASE_REDEPARTURE_FORBIDDEN.summary: After the first return to Camp, the route cannot leave again.
BASE_REDEPARTURE_FORBIDDEN.next: Keep all post-return stances inside Camp or finish the outside work before returning.

ACTION_AFTER_BASE_RETURN.summary: No new action or WORLD release may occur after returning to Camp.
ACTION_AFTER_BASE_RETURN.next: Finish WORLD actions before return; only an already-carried recovery may release to BASE.

BASE_WITHDRAWAL_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.summary: One expedition may withdraw at most one new Base stone.
BASE_WITHDRAWAL_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.next: Use existing WORLD stones or exposed terrain for additional actions.

BASE_PICKUP_AFTER_DEPARTURE.summary: A Base stone must be picked up before the first departure.
BASE_PICKUP_AFTER_DEPARTURE.next: Bind the Base pickup to a pre-departure route stance.

SPAWN_CORE_PROTECTED.summary: Matter cannot be placed, quarried, or rearranged inside the Spawn Core.
SPAWN_CORE_PROTECTED.next: Choose a cell outside the protected horizontal cylinder.

BASE_IMPORT_INSIDE_CAMP.summary: A new Base stone must be imported outside Base Camp.
BASE_IMPORT_INSIDE_CAMP.next: Choose a WORLD destination beyond the Camp boundary.

BASE_PICKUP_OUTSIDE_CAMP.summary: A BASE pickup stance must be inside Everest Base Camp.
BASE_PICKUP_OUTSIDE_CAMP.next: Bind the pickup to an in-Camp route stance.

BASE_RELEASE_OUTSIDE_CAMP.summary: A BASE recovery release stance must be inside Everest Base Camp.
BASE_RELEASE_OUTSIDE_CAMP.next: Carry the matter into Camp before releasing it to BASE.

UNSAFE_TERMINAL.summary: A non-Base terminal point must be declared safe and satisfy walking slope.
UNSAFE_TERMINAL.next: Use a nearbySafeStops hint or choose another walk-safe endpoint and set safeStop: true.

OUTSIDE_TERRAIN.summary: A decoded stance lies outside the authoritative terrain.
OUTSIDE_TERRAIN.next: Choose exact cells returned by site:query or terrain:query.

ENDURANCE_EXHAUSTED.summary: The integrated route energy exceeds the expedition capacity.
ENDURANCE_EXHAUSTED.next: Shorten or lower the route, reduce loaded distance, or end at a viable one-way safe stop.

STONE_ALREADY_EXISTS.summary: The proposed matter ID already exists.
STONE_ALREADY_EXISTS.next: Use a unique matterId for a Base import or terrain relocation.

STONE_NOT_FOUND.summary: The source stone is absent from the selected world state.
STONE_NOT_FOUND.next: Refresh world:query and use the current stone ID and cell.

TERRAIN_VOXEL_NOT_EXPOSED.summary: A terrain voxel may be quarried only from exterior air or an existing excavation face.
TERRAIN_VOXEL_NOT_EXPOSED.next: Start at an exposed voxel and advance inward one action at a time.

NO_STATE_CHANGE.summary: The ordered actions leave no canonical world change.
NO_STATE_CHANGE.next: Remove same-cell or canceling relocations and produce a real final matter change.

DESTINATION_OCCUPIED.summary: A WORLD destination cell is already occupied.
DESTINATION_OCCUPIED.next: Refresh world:query or choose another exact integer cell.

DESTINATION_HAS_NO_FACE_CONTACT.summary: A placed stone must share a face with solid terrain or another stone.
DESTINATION_HAS_NO_FACE_CONTACT.next: Choose a grounded or face-connected destination cell.

STONE_UNANCHORED.summary: An affected face-connected stone component has no terrain anchor.
STONE_UNANCHORED.next: Add or preserve at least one stone directly supported by solid terrain.

STONE_IMBALANCED.summary: The component center of mass lies outside its safe anchor footprint.
STONE_IMBALANCED.next: Widen or reposition the anchored base, or rebalance the component.

STONE_SPAN_EXCEEDED.summary: Horizontal support would have to travel beyond the permitted reach.
STONE_SPAN_EXCEEDED.next: Shorten the span, thicken it, or add an independently stable support.

STONE_COMPRESSION_EXCEEDED.summary: Average load per anchor cell exceeds the static compression limit.
STONE_COMPRESSION_EXCEEDED.next: Increase the anchor footprint or reduce the supported mass.

STONE_LATERAL_OVERTURNING.summary: The structure is too tall for its smaller anchored base dimension.
STONE_LATERAL_OVERTURNING.next: Widen the base, buttress the structure, or reduce its height.

TUNNEL_ROOF_TOO_THIN.summary: The excavation leaves too little solid roof.
TUNNEL_ROOF_TOO_THIN.next: Move the tunnel deeper or preserve more solid roof cells.

TUNNEL_RADIUS_EXCEEDED.summary: A cavity cell is too far from solid side material.
TUNNEL_RADIUS_EXCEEDED.next: Narrow the room or add ordinary stone pillars or partitions.

AFFECTED_STONES_TOO_LARGE.summary: One affected stone component exceeds the bounded verifier size.
AFFECTED_STONES_TOO_LARGE.next: Partition the design into independently stable components or stages.

STRUCTURE_TOO_TALL_FOR_FULL_RECHECK.summary: The affected component spans too many distinct levels for one recheck.
STRUCTURE_TOO_TALL_FOR_FULL_RECHECK.next: Partition the design into independently stable stages.

CAVITY_WINDOW_TOO_LARGE.summary: The changed cavity exceeds the bounded local verification window.
CAVITY_WINDOW_TOO_LARGE.next: Split excavation into smaller independently valid stages.

TOO_MANY_CHUNKS_TOUCHED.summary: One mutation touches too many physics chunks.
TOO_MANY_CHUNKS_TOUCHED.next: Reduce the spatial extent of the action or stage the work.

EXPEDITION_PHYSICS_BUDGET_EXCEEDED.summary: The cumulative action sequence exceeds one expedition's physics budget.
EXPEDITION_PHYSICS_BUDGET_EXCEEDED.next: Split the project into smaller independently stable expeditions.

TERRAIN_CONTEXT_MISSING.summary: Static validation lacks authoritative terrain context.
TERRAIN_CONTEXT_MISSING.next: Run the public full verifier against a canonical world and terrain authority.

WORLD_BOUNDS_EXCEEDED.summary: A proposed cell lies outside the public world bounds.
WORLD_BOUNDS_EXCEEDED.next: Choose a destination within the canonical Everest coordinate space.

ROUTE_INVALID.summary: The route failed a public lifecycle, terrain, movement, or Endurance rule.
ROUTE_INVALID.next: Use routeCode and its rule guidance to revise the route.

PHYSICS_INVALID.summary: A pickup-only or post-release matter state failed static verification.
PHYSICS_INVALID.next: Use the physics code and --diagnose output to revise the action sequence.
